FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. The French word for “book” is: (1 mark)
   A. fenêtre
   B. livre
   C. porte
   D. chaise

2. When practising Interactive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Listening.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Listening.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Listening.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Interactive Listening.

3. When practising Oral Expression Clarity Intonation Pacing, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression Clarity Intonation Pacing.

   A. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Speaking.

   D. Copy random text without understanding Interactive Speaking.

7. When practising Oral Expression Clarity Intonation Tone, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Oral Expression Clarity Intonation Tone.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expression Clarity Intonation Tone.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Oral Expression Clarity Intonation Tone.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression Clarity Intonation Tone.

8. When practising Active listening 1.4 Listening for information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active listening 1.4 Listening for information.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Active listening 1.4 Listening for information.

10. “Bonjour” is used to say: (1 mark)
   A. Good morning / hello
   B. Thank you
   C. Good night only
   D. Excuse me

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Guided reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Reading Aloud Tone Clarity Voice projection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
